study type: longitudinal retrospective design and qualitative case studies
exposure: indications of fraud by health workers
cohort: Delivery women at Banyuwangi referral hospital before and during JKN implementation.
finding: The proportion of cesarean delivery increased significantly during the implementation of JKN.
mod_finding: Indications of fraud by health workers, repeated cesarean delivery, delayed referral, and the number of obstetric complications were found to be contributing factors to the increased proportion of cesarean delivery.
